items.limitations: Orbital energies and gaps are model-dependent and do not establish a binding free energy or experimental optical gap.
items.statement: A validated isolated-HL calculation supports the qualitative author hypothesis that the conjugated ligand has a stable frontier electronic structure and frontier-orbital localization consistent with donor behavior and possible ICT.
